hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json, sys; data = json.load(sys.stdin); cmd = data.get("tool_input", {}).get("CommandLine", ""); sys.exit(2) if ("git push" in cmd and ("--force" in cmd or "-f" in cmd)) else sys.exit(0)'
hooks.description: Block force-pushes during active PR review sessions

hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json, os, sys, datetime; data = json.load(sys.stdin); target = data.get("tool_input", {}).get("TargetFile", ""); plugin_data = os.environ.get("PLUGIN_DATA", "/tmp"); os.makedirs(plugin_data, exist_ok=True); open(os.path.join(plugin_data, "review_audit.log"), "a").write(f"{datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()} wrote {target}\n")'
hooks.description: Record generated review artifacts in PLUGIN_DATA/review_audit.log
